messages:
incbot: :rotating_light: ALERT: metroline-prod (Enterprise: MetroLine Transit) experiencing elevated 5xx rate on /v1/embeddings and P95 latency spike. Trigger: 5xx > 2% for 5m, embeddings latency P95 3.2s. Incident ID: INC-2026-0423

sam_oncall: Ack. Looking. Paging oncall rotation + will triage.

ryan_platform: I'm on infra. Seeing increased CPU and OOM retries on a small subset of dedicated hosts serving metroline. Graphics: host-gpu-12 and host-gpu-18.

sam_oncall: Thx. I'll start fallback to lower-capacity embedding model for metroline via routing policy. Can one of infra/ops run a graceful drain on host-gpu-12 after draining KV cache?

alex_ops: On it. I'll cordon host-gpu-12 and trigger drain policy now. Command: 
```bash
./infra/drain-host --host host-gpu-12 --grace 60s --preserve-kv false
```

maria_cs: Maria (CS) here — MetroLine account team pinged us. They reported search relevance regressions and timeouts in production dashboards. They ask for an ETA and whether we will page their on-call.

sam_oncall: Maria — we're doing a targeted routing fallback to a compatible model variant (emb-lite-1) with lower memory footprint. Expected mitigation within ~3-5 minutes. I'll post a short customer-facing blurb for the status page for you to review.

emily_pm: Need tailored impact statement for MetroLine (enterprise SLA). They require account-level comms and phone escalation. Maria, can you confirm primary AM & contacts?

maria_cs: AM: christine@metroline.com, secondary: jamal@metroline.com, phone: +1-415-555-0190. They want both phone + email.

ryan_platform: Drain started. host-gpu-12 connections draining, moving active sessions to host-gpu-18 and fallback pool. Observed drop in 5xx already to 1.4%. Latency P95 down to 1.1s after initial routing change.

sam_oncall: Nice. Please prepare status page update. Suggested text below — internal review only first: 

statusbot: DRAFT STATUS PAGE UPDATE (internal):
"We are investigating elevated error rates and latency affecting MetroLine Transit customers on embeddings endpoints. Traffic has been routed to a compatible fallback model and affected hosts are being drained for remediation. We expect restoration of normal service within 15 minutes. If you continue to experience issues, please contact support@redwood.ai or your account manager. Incident ID: INC-2026-0423."

maria_cs: Good. For MetroLine public-facing message we should call out phone escalation and apologize for degraded search. I'll add: "We are actively paging your account team and can be reached at +1-415-555-0190."

emily_pm: OK. Customer notification (email/phone) template for Christine/Jamal: 
"Hi Christine — we’re investigating a short outage impacting embeddings/search relevance. We’ve routed traffic to a fallback model and are draining affected hosts. Estimated mitigation: <15 minutes>. We will follow up when fully restored. If you need immediate assistance we are available by phone: +1-415-555-0190."

sam_oncall: Good. @maria_cs and @emily_pm — Maria, please send the email and offer a call. Sam will be available for technical handoff.

alex_ops: host-gpu-12 drained successfully. Evacuated sessions and restarted runtime on host-gpu-12 with new mem config. P95 stabilized ~0.9s. No further OOMs observed.

ryan_platform: Running postmortem checks on KV cache fragmentation and model client mem spikes. Collecting logs: 
```bash
./logs/collect -i INC-2026-0423 --hosts host-gpu-12,host-gpu-18 > /tmp/INC-2026-0423-logs.tgz\```

sam_oncall: Closing loop: mitigation successful, routing fallback will be lifted in 30m after monitoring window. Maria — please confirm customer notified and whether they want a tailored status page public blurb.

maria_cs: Sent email to Christine & Jamal, called primary — they acknowledged and asked for a post-incident summary. They want SLA credit evaluation.

emily_pm: Note for customer comms: include root cause is under investigation (probable memory regression on model client) and we'll share post-incident analysis.

sam_oncall: Thanks team. I’ll mark incident as Mitigated and set a follow-up postmortem with infra + runtime for 24h.

incbot: INCIDENT STATUS CHANGE: INC-2026-0423 -> MITIGATED by sam_oncall at 1823456845

statusbot: PUBLIC STATUS PAGE UPDATE (scheduled):
"We resolved an incident affecting embeddings for MetroLine Transit. Traffic was temporarily routed to a fallback model while we drained affected hosts. Services are back to normal. We will publish a detailed post-incident report within 72 hours. If you need anything urgent, contact your account manager or support@redwood.ai."

sam_oncall: Postmortem owners: ryan_platform, alex_ops, emily_pm. I'll create the postmortem doc with timeline.

maria_cs: Confirming MetroLine wants PI (post-incident) and SLA credit eval. I'll open a support case and loop AMs.

emily_pm: Adding action items: 1) Runtime memory regression check, 2) Improve host drain automation for dedicated pools, 3) Customer communication template update to include phone escalation flow.

sam_oncall: Thanks everyone. Ending thread. :white_check_mark:"
